project: Southern Cumberland Escarpment Karst Cold-Air Pooling & Plateau-Cap Phenology (v2 Revised)

hypothesis_ledger.claim: 50% deciduous escarpment green-up (MODIS MidGreenup_1) tracks Hopkins (1918) 3.28 d/100 m; 15% Greenup_1 lapses faster due to phenological threshold definition rather than QA/conifer artifacts
hypothesis_ledger.key_metric: Clean MODIS MidGreenup_1 (2001-2023, QA<=1, NLCD-41): lapse = 3.19 +/- 0.17 SE (0.82 SD) d/100 m (Hopkins = 3.28); 3-factor GEE decomposition: QA delta=0.0, NLCD-41 delta=0.007, 50%-vs-15% delta=-0.797 d/100 m; lapse trend = -0.047 d/100m/dec (p=0.8601); thermal sens = -2.40 +/- 0.65 SE d/C (r=-0.626, p=0.001403); unharmonized Landsat 2013 step non-identifiable due to collinearity (step=-0.42 +/- 3.69 SE d, p=0.91); raw GHCN-Daily Sewanee (unhomogenized for TOBS/hiatus): Mar-Apr +0.83 C (p=0.0292), frost-free +10.1 d (p=0.02124)

hypothesis_ledger.claim: Signal A (Lost Cove) and Signal B (Plateau cap) are not solar-geometry/BRDF or timber-harvest artifacts (internal gate P2 = PARTIAL_OR_FAIL due to sigA_pass=false & decoupling fail)
hypothesis_ledger.key_metric: Signal A SCS+C retention: 99.6% SOS / 98.1% EOS; HLS v2.0 NDVI dSOS=+3.33 d, NDRE dSOS=+3.10 d, dEOS=-2.45 d (internal gate P2 sigA_pass=False); Signal B persists across all 4 aspect quadrants (N/E/S/W: +2.30 to +2.61 d SCS+C NDRE; +2.77 to +3.32 d HLS NDVI) and after masking all 120 LAL harvest polygons (Sig A descriptive N=1 cove diff=+5.28 d; Sig B=+2.62 d, 1km block med p=5.481e-05, 2km block med p=0.00105)

hypothesis_ledger.claim: Closed karst basins regionally compress deciduous growing season vs. matched open gorges after relief adjustment and rim-free floor-vs-floor comparison, inside identical EVTs (internal gate P1 = PARTIAL_PASS)
hypothesis_ledger.key_metric: 11 regional closed-open pairs (NDRE): relief-adjusted 22-site CR1 OLS (df=10): dSOS=+4.28 +/- 1.13 SE d (p=0.003465), dEOS=-4.79 +/- 1.13 SE d (p=0.001727), dGSL=-9.07 +/- 1.81 SE d (p=0.0005266; unadjusted paired DiD=-11.14 d, inflated by 51.8 m relief imbalance); rim-free dz_floor-adjusted floor-vs-floor: dGSL=-8.75 +/- 1.85 SE d (p=0.001074); within-EVT dz_floor-adjusted: EVT 3317 dGSL=-11.17 +/- 2.61 SE d (p=0.002689), EVT 3321 dGSL=-6.78 +/- 1.87 SE d (p=0.006735); binary is_closed partial R2=54.4% over Relief (total R2=0.725, dAICc=-17.14 vs Relief+TPI300; no depth ramp >22 m, 0-22 m unobserved); P1 internal gate PARTIAL_PASS (open dEOS=-3.03 d, r_sigmaSOS=0.22)

hypothesis_ledger.claim: Closed karst floors exhibit nocturnal cold-air pooling in cloud-leak-filtered ECOSTRESS TIR across seasons and 7/7 16SED coves, collapsing at Lost Cove over 2.5-3.0 m/s
hypothesis_ledger.key_metric: Cloud-leak-filtered (|LST-ERA5_t2m|<=10 C, dropping 8 corrupted/cloud v002 scenes, 0/14 v003) n=52 clean / 157 in-swath nights: Spring=-0.96 +/- 0.22 SE C (n=19, t p=0.000423, Wilcoxon p=0.0003357); Autumn=-1.49 +/- 0.29 SE C (n=33, t p=1.068e-05); Lost Cove wind collapse (2.5-3.0 m/s only, n=0 >=3.0 m/s): calm (<2.5 m/s, n=44)=-1.52 +/- 0.20 SE C vs breezy (2.5-3.0 m/s, n=7)=+0.33 +/- 0.43 SE C (Welch p=0.004089, MW p=0.001884; does not replicate across 6 other 16SED coves using Sewanee wind, p=0.7718); Multi-cove 16SED replication: 7/7 coves individually significant (cove-level calm mean=-1.09 +/- 0.22 SE C, p=0.002385); CAVEAT: swath Manski bounds span 0 (combined cloud-only [-8.12, +6.28 C]; v002 [-7.12, +5.34 C]; v003 [-8.09, +6.05 C])

hypothesis_ledger.claim: Signal B (Flat Plateau spring lag vs Steep Rim) is consistent with upland oak guild turnover rather than modeled wet-fragipan soil thermal inertia
hypothesis_ledger.key_metric: Modeled fragipan soil inertia FALSIFIED: within-flat fragipan vs well-drained = +0.32 d (1km med p=0.6792, 2km med p=0.6614), 25-yr Mar-Apr precip r=0.202 (p=0.33); Plateau lag robust across all 25 grid origins at 1km & 2km: raw +3.53 d (2km p<=1.077e-05), well-drained +3.15 d (2km p<=7.13e-06), unharvested LAL +2.62 d (2km p<=0.003222), 25/25 Landsat yrs (+2.39 +/- 1.61 SD d); Consistent with oak guild turnover (no species-plot data): standardized oct_mari_z beta=+0.53 d/SD (single-var nested dR2=+0.020; oct_mari diff +0.120 is 2km grid-sensitive: p=0.01746..0.09352, 36% < 0.05)

hypothesis_ledger.claim: Internal-criterion S2 vertical canopy-understory decoupling (dSOS_NDVI - dSOS_NDRE) tracks April freeze severity
hypothesis_ledger.key_metric: Internal S2 April freeze gate FAILED (freeze vs mild p=0.762, r_AprTmin=-0.204); HLS showed r=-0.785 (p=0.036); post-hoc DOY>100 frost split (+1.70 vs -0.84 d, p=0.025) is exploratory only (n=7)

hypothesis_ledger.claim: Interannual CalmOctFreeze nights amplify closed-cove early EOS across a 25-yr (2000-2024) 4-cove Landsat panel
hypothesis_ledger.key_metric: Lost Cove 25-yr medians +2.45 d SOS (88% >0) / -2.53 d EOS (80% <0), though OLS means are n.s. (+1.62 +/- 1.42 SE d p=0.27; -2.22 +/- 1.34 SE d p=0.11); 2018-2024 vs HLS EOS r=0.961 (p=0.00056) but spring SOS r=-0.041 (p=0.93); 4-cove panel CalmOctFreeze_z showed OPPOSITE sign (beta=+1.18 d, p=0.03451; HardRegionalFreeze beta=+1.85 d, p=0.014); Lost Cove OctNightWspd n.s. hypothesis_ledger.claim: Standalone supplementary audit: AlphaEarth 64-d annual embeddings vs. matched-capacity Raw Sentinel-2 + 3DEP (excluded from main manuscript)

disqualified_basins_archive.note: All 6 excluded regional basins are archived directly from profiling/p1.json. Specifically, Lost_Cove_TN (48.7% 30m NLCD-41, 38.4% pasture) and Sinking_Cove_TN (57.1% 30m NLCD-41) fell below the 60% deciduous-floor criterion and therefore sit outside the 11 P1 phenology pairs; both join 5 P1 basins in the 7-cove ECOSTRESS tile 16SED thermal replication. Karst_AL_15 collapsed to 0 m fill depth at 30 m.

4B_ecostress_thermal_closure.cloud_leak_filter: |LST - ERA5_t2m| <= 10.0 C on both Lost Cove and OpenN

unfiltered_diagnostics.note: Applying a physical |LST - ERA5_t2m| <= 10 C screen removes 8 unflagged ECOv002 scenes (7 cloud-contaminated scenes with LST 11-22 C below ERA5 t2m and 1 calibration-corrupted pre-dawn scene at +46 to +48 C; 0/14 v003 scenes are flagged), including all 3 scenes with u10 >= 3.0 m/s. Filtering strengthens cooling across every season and makes spring cleanly significant on both parametric t-test and Wilcoxon.

continuous_wind_regression.wind_collapse_scope_note: All 7 clean breezy nights lie in 2.5 <= u10 < 3.0 m/s (0 clean nights >= 3.0 m/s once 3 cloud-leaked v002 scenes are removed). Wind-collapse inference is scoped strictly to Lost Cove over 2.5-3.0 m/s; it does not replicate across the 6 other 16SED coves when using Sewanee point ERA5 wind (paired calm vs. breezy p = 0.77).

multicove_16sed.screen_rule: Sewanee-verified clear v002 granules (lst_lost & lst_openn observed and |LST - ERA5_t2m| <= 10 C)

legacy_landsat_step.interpretation: Collinearity non-identifiability (r(year, I[year>=2013]) = 0.80, VIF = 2.7): neither the 2013 processor-era step (-0.42 +/- 3.69 d, p = 0.9103) nor the secular slope (-1.58 +/- 1.46 d/dec, p = 0.2878) can be separated cleanly in unharmonized Collection 2 Landsat.

4C_hopkins_climate_lal.noaa_homogenization_caveat: Raw GHCN-Daily station records are unhomogenized for time-of-observation bias (TOBS), sensor transitions (liquid-in-glass to MMTS/electronic), or micro-site relocations across the 1944-1999 hiatus; century-scale era shifts provide contextual background rather than formal climate-attribution estimates.
